reviews.title: Be fair all the way
reviews.text: I enjoy the game very much, and I understand the changes for you guys to make money. Getting the heroic key from the shop used to just cost gems, but then you change it to include 3 keys but now it cost actual money. The booster packs would give a specific legendary or heroic, but now it’s blue or mystery now. I can forgive all that. But the accuracy change to the items I don’t quite understand. If you’re going for realism, then when enemies spawn or walk over fire or spikes then they should take damage just like I do. My throws are all over the place now, but there’s no punishment for the monsters walking in literal fire? That’s my only real gripe. I do enjoy the game and I was saying for a while I hope there was an update coming and sure enough there it was. There’s still lots of work to do though.

reviews.title: Massively Flawed Progression
reviews.text: Recently, I reset my progress completely to test a particular issue that plagues late game in regards to event difficulty. Unfortunately, my findings did confirm my hunch that the event difficulty ramps up way too fast after area 5. This alone will keep me there indefinitely until I can scrape up enough Hero Essence. Now, this could be in part to the fact that Hero Essence, one of the two most important kinds alongside Weapon Essence, almost never drops. Even if, and big if, I bought every level pack with Hero Essence, that is a singular Legendary Hero at only 3 stars, which will get outclassed by area 8 in events. Beyond that, there’s not a single, guaranteed chance for it to drop, despite the upgrade menu implying that it can in dungeons. My personal recommendation would be to have the events give you 3 options of essence at the end, allowing for a mix of random and control that follow

reviews.title: impossible game
reviews.text:
the game, although riddled with bugs, was fun for a little. but it becomes too hard to even bother loading in.

the game becomes literally impossible. the difficulty of the events that are the only way to uncap and upgrade your gear become gradually harder until they become legitimately impossible to clear.

the bosses and enemies not only become HP sponges, but they also gain faster attack speed and movement speed.
this makes for a state where you cannot possibly dodge them, as they will rush you or literally fill the arena with projectiles and there is nothing you can do to move out of harm. 
the player hitbox combined with the player movement speed is not small or fast enough to possibly evade most of the scaled enemies or bosses attacks.
basically the only way to win a single time is to roll multiple extra lives (and use your one revive) and perfect boss attack features on the level

Game is fun to play, even though it’s an Archero knockoff. Graphics are cool, but I don’t like some of the enemies when they attack the colors are hard to spot because they blend with other things in the map. Also when the monsters bounce from one area to another, they are in-hitable. Also there seems to be a bug with the pvp button. Can press it, credit the action, and then no feature happens.

Overall not as good as Archero, which is much more well rounded. Also it’s very hard to progress in this game, and the descriptions of the skills are weak. Also I wish there was a recommended build tree somewhere. It’s hard to know what skills to build off of.

reviews.title: In-App Price is Way Too High
reviews.text:
A month ago, the price of in-app purchases increased so much. Battle Pass $4.99 -> $7.99,
VIP Sub $4.99 -> $7.99, 6500 gems $49.99 -> $89.99, 14000 gems $99.99 -> $169.99, Berserk $9.99 -> $16.99, Shinobi, Vixen, Huntress now cost $34.99 each. 

I thought it was done by mistake and they gonna fix it, but no, it still shows these new price tags. It’s simply too much for rogue-like game. Archero has so much better in-app purchase pricing, and multi-player systems like PVP/Duo/Guild/Chat when Combat Quest is a pure single player game.

And the screen display (resolution) is terrible on iPads because it’s using a display made for iPhone, so iPads owners need to stretch the iPhone display which makes everything look blur.
